definitions.explanation: The hidden side of society where criminal and illicit activities take place. Encompasses organized crime, black markets, and illegal networks operating outside the law.

examples.japanese: {裏社会|うらしゃかい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧つながり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発覚|はっかく}した→発覚する：15423_hakkakusuru⟧。
examples.english: His connections to the underworld were exposed.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{裏社会|うらしゃかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{実態|じったい}→実態：10567_jittai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}いている→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
examples.english: That movie depicts the reality of the underworld.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{裏社会|うらしゃかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{流|なが}れる→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧⟦{資金|しきん}→資金：09937_shikin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ルート→ルート：11250_ruuto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{追|お}っている→追う：02016_ou⟧。
examples.english: The police are tracking the flow of funds into the underworld.

notes:
Literally "back society" or "reverse-side society." The prefix ⟦{裏|うら}→裏：02178_ura⟧ (back, hidden side) contrasts with ⟦{表|おもて}→表：01355_omote⟧ (front, public side), reflecting the idea of a hidden world operating behind the visible surface of society. Frequently encountered in crime fiction, news reports, and documentaries.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {裏社会|うらしゃかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧: people from the underworld
- {裏社会|うらしゃかい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧つながり: connections to the underworld
- {裏社会|うらしゃかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏|ふ}み{入|い}れる: to set foot in the underworld
- {裏社会|うらしゃかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{牛耳|ぎゅうじ}る: to control the underworld

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {闇社会|やみしゃかい}: dark society — nearly synonymous, slightly more dramatic
- ⟦{暗黒街|あんこくがい}→暗黒街：22663_ankokugai⟧: dark streets — emphasizes specific criminal districts
- ⟦{犯罪組織|はんざいそしき}→犯罪組織：26956_hanzaisoshiki⟧: criminal organization — refers to specific groups rather than the broader world
